headword: {遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}
reading: いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ

definitions.explanation: An office or counter at a station, airport, public facility, or police jurisdiction where items lost by the public are received, held, and returned to their owners. The formal term seen on signs at train stations and on railway websites.

examples.japanese: {遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせて→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧みて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please try contacting the station's lost-and-found office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}した→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
examples.english: I left my umbrella on the train, so I called the lost-and-found office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、なくした⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The airport lost-and-found office contacted me to say that the wallet I had lost had been found.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{遺失物|いしつぶつ}→遺失物：15652_ishitsubutsu⟧ (lost article) and {取扱所|とりあつかいじょ} (handling office, counter). The formal, signage-style term for what is commonly called a 'lost and found' in English.

USAGE:
Seen on signage and on official websites of railway companies ({JR}、⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦メトロ→メトロ：27576_metoro⟧、etc.), airports, and police stations. In spoken Japanese, speakers often use shorter variants like ⟦{遺失物|いしつぶつ}→遺失物：15652_ishitsubutsu⟧⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧ or ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}: the station lost-and-found
- {遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧: to inquire at the lost-and-found office
- {遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to hand in / turn in (a found item) at the lost-and-found
- {遺失物取扱所|いしつぶつとりあつかいじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}される→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to be kept at the lost-and-found

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧: lost-and-found center — the more everyday term, common at railway companies' consumer-facing websites
- ⟦{遺失物|いしつぶつ}→遺失物：15652_ishitsubutsu⟧⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧: lost-property center — near-synonym; same scope, slightly more formal register
- ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧{保管所|ほかんじょ}: found-items storage — emphasizes holding items until claimed
- ⟦{拾得物|しゅうとくぶつ}→拾得物：23045_shuutokubutsu⟧: found article — the legal counterpart of ⟦{遺失物|いしつぶつ}→遺失物：15652_ishitsubutsu⟧, referring to the item from the finder's perspective
